t: How the prayer was first given
a: فَرَضَ اللَّهُ الصَّلاَةَ حِينَ فَرَضَهَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي الْحَضَرِ وَالسَّفَرِ، فَأُقِرَّتْ صَلاَةُ السَّفَرِ، وَزِيدَ فِي صَلاَةِ الْحَضَرِ
p: Faraḍa-Llāhu-ṣ-ṣalāta ḥīna faraḍahā rakʿatayni rakʿatayni fi-l-ḥaḍari wa-s-safar, fa-uqirrat ṣalātu-s-safar, wa zīda fī ṣalāti-l-ḥaḍar
m: When Allah made the prayer obligatory He made it two units and two units, at home and on a journey. Then the travelling prayer was left as it was, and the prayer at home was increased.
